name: Wappalyzer
summary: Technographics: the technologies behind any website (CMS, analytics, ecommerce, frameworks), with optional company, contact and social details, plus subdomain discovery.

api_key.description: A Wappalyzer API key (wappalyzer.com > account > API). Sent in the x-api-key header; the API needs a Business plan.

notes: Every call spends credits; each response's wappalyzer-credits-spent and wappalyzer-credits-remaining headers give the charge and the balance. 403 also means out of credits.
Rate limit: 10 requests per second; 429 when exceeded.
Lead lists and suppression lists are not in this entry: they create and spend on account records.

endpoints.name: Look up a website's technologies
endpoints.summary: Technologies detected on up to ten websites, with versions, categories and confidence; sets adds company, contact, social, locale and meta fields.

urls.description: One to ten website URLs, comma-separated, with scheme.

recursive.description: Follow internal links for more coverage; default true. Set false for a shallow scan answered in the same call; recursive=false takes one URL only.

live.description: Scan in real time instead of the cached dataset; default false. Only with recursive=false here: a live recursive scan needs a callback, which this entry does not take.

sets.description: Comma-separated extra field sets (e.g. meta,social), or all; see the Fields page.

min_age.description: Only results verified at least this many calendar months ago (UTC); default 0.

max_age.description: Only results verified within this many calendar months; default 2, max 12. 0 is the current month only.

squash.description: Merge months into one result set; default true. false groups results by month (history).

notes: 1 credit per URL. Cached results come back at once; when a site is not in the dataset, a recursive lookup starts a crawl (up to 15 minutes) and the first answer holds no technologies yet: repeat the same request later, free for up to an hour, or use recursive=false.

endpoints.name: Find a domain's subdomains
endpoints.summary: Website-serving subdomains seen for up to ten domains, with first and last seen times.

after.description: Next page: the moreAfter value of the previous answer.

notes: 1 credit per 10 subdomains returned. Coverage is website-serving hosts from Wappalyzer's crawl, not a full DNS inventory.

endpoints.name: Verify an email address
endpoints.summary: Whether an email address is deliverable.
